description: This file defines and exports functions related to fetching and handling the current user profile information, including making API calls to backend endpoints to retrieve user data and optionally storing display name information.

methods.name: getCurrentUserProfile()
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile information from the backend API, including user_id if available, by calling GET /users/me with proper authorization.

methods.name: getCurrentUserProfileWithUserId(userId)
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile explicitly using a provided userId to ensure the request URL includes ?user_id=<id>.

methods.name: fetchAndStoreDisplayName(saveAuthFunc, userId)
methods.description: Fetches the user's display name, either using a specific userId or the current authenticated user, and optionally saves it using a provided saveAuthFunc callback.
